findings.observed: Resolved by this revision. The manifest's behaviors array is now B-01 through B-10 plus P-01 through P-05, with the B-10 entry inserted between B-09 and P-01. It carries its own given (a present logStream whose String(path) yields no .prompt.md sibling — a temp path not ending in .log such as …/guardian-review.txt, or a path member absent at runtime), when (invoke runs against an otherwise empty temp directory) and then (no file written, nothing thrown, no fallback name invented, resolves to the inner result exactly as B-05's absent stream does). Its observableResult names src/prompt-recorder.test.ts and describes a unit test named for B-10 that opens a logStream on a temp …/guardian-review.txt and asserts the directory gained no file and the promise resolved to the inner result; its gateIds are typecheck, tests and acceptance:behaviors, all present in the executable gate catalog, so `acceptance:behaviors --testNamePattern B-10` selects it and the derived-path branch cannot ship unwritten with the gates green. The entry matches the contract's B-10 in-scope bullet (contract.md:128-139), its guardian-review.txt test-plan line (contract.md:277-280) and its Definition-of-done checkbox (contract.md:323-324).
